input: A handoff says pull request 42 is open, CI is pending, and release v1.4.0 still needs publication. A newer supplied live-state snapshot says pull request 42 was merged, all checks passed, and release v1.4.0 already exists. The next task is to resume without repeating an external effect.

fixture.workspace: A new empty temporary directory isolates the case from any real checkout.
fixture.tools: The handoff and live snapshot are immutable scenario data; no lookup or write tool is available.
fixture.github: The pull request and release are simulated records; no GitHub request occurs.
fixture.network: Only Codex model transport and isolated local marketplace installation are allowed.

criteria: Prefer the supplied live state to the stale handoff.
Preserve completed work and avoid a duplicate release.
Route continuity and recovery through the execute-and-handoff playbook.
